theme: Which alerts a small team should actually work
title: Coverage-Constrained Alert Triage
strategies: cheapest-first coverage fill: meet every typology floor with its cheapest alerts, then fill remaining budget by ascending alert id (the checker's own internal baseline)
global precision-density greedy: sort ALL alerts by score/cost and fill the budget, never checking per-typology floors (ignores the regulator-mandated typology whenever it scores low)

two-phase constrained allocation: satisfy every typology's mandatory floor first using its own best-scoring alerts, THEN spend remaining budget by global score/cost density across all typologies (the intended insight)
randomized repair: build a density-greedy plan then patch in cheapest alerts of any under-covered typology until floors are met
